We need to generate new test cases for newJsonSchema method, avoiding duplication with existing ones. Identify untested combos: e.g., schemaUri with fragment, relative URI, different scheme (file, classpath), schemaNode with array of objects, schemaNode with invalid format (non-object), config with custom settings (e.g., failFast true), config with null values, schemaNode with $id field, schemaNode with empty object, schemaNode with boolean schema (true/false), schemaNode with unknown keywords, schemaNode with meta-schema $schema referencing older draft, handling of URIs that need normalization (normalizeMetaSchemaUri), handling of URIs with trailing slash, handling of URI with query parameters, handling of schemaNode that is a JSON number (should still create?), maybe expecting IllegalArgumentException.

Also test that when config has custom typeLoose flag, internal context respects it. Also test that when schemaUri is a malformed URI (throws URISyntaxException) but method signature takes URI so can't pass malformed string; we can pass a URI with illegal characters but still a URI object.

Test with config having typeLoose = true.

Test with config having custom format validators.

Test with schemaUri null and config null.

Test with schemaUri pointing to a classpath resource (e.g., "classpath:/schemas/schema.json") – but URI scheme "classpath" maybe not recognized; still should accept.

Test with schemaUri having fragment part, e.g., "http://example.com/schema.json#/definitions/foo". The method passes schemaUri to doCreate as currentUri; maybe fragment is ignored.

7. "Schema node with $id and $schema – meta-schema handling"

9. "Schema node as array of objects – test array schema"
